order any size. we'll resize free within 30 days at any of 300+ mia stores. or ship a ring sizer to your address beforehand for ₹0. we've thought about this. a lot.

yes. pick the date at checkout. we hold and dispatch to arrive on the exact day. delivery windows: 9am-1pm or 4pm-8pm. add a handwritten note free.
every piece is bis hallmarked, engraved with the karatage (14/18/22k), assay centre mark, and a unique hallmark number. plus a signed certificate of authenticity in the box. diamonds come with igi/ags/gia certification, listed per piece.
